source_text: Implevit Deus Beselehel spiritu sapientiae. Omnis ars ecclesiae a Spiritu. Tabernaculum — corpus Christi et congregatio sanctorum. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Filled God Bezaleel with-spirit of-wisdom. Every art of-church from Spirit. Tabernacle — body of-Christ and congregation of-saints. Amen.
pass_b_english: God filled [[Bezaleel with the spirit of wisdom >> Bible:Exodus 31:2-3]]. Every craft of the church is from the Spirit. The tabernacle is Christ’s body and the congregation of the saints. Amen.
